items.title: observe() adds a resize listener on every mount (one more per Legacy to Glass switch) and registerGlass adds a second, unthrottled one that pins the column and probes the board on every resize event
items.old_state: fixed in 1.2.43 (AUDIT-1.2.42.md section 2.2, line 244); also listed among the '34 ID' of section 9 (line 634)

Commit 90c17021 (12.09.2026).

items.note: Under Monokuma Legacy a resize still costs one debounced refreshGlass(), which returns at glassRoom() with nothing mounted.

items.title: The Reduced motion switch is hidden under Monokuma Legacy in both windows although it stills the whole module's motion there too

new_observations.title: A test holds CONTRIBUTING.md to a Legacy floor of 10 px while two other tests hold the sheet to 11 px
new_observations.what: R1313 requires the CSS contract to say '10 px' and CONTRIBUTING.md and typography.md say Legacy's floor is 10 px a rung ('the rungs from 10 to 14 carry max(10px, ...)'); since E48 K6 --drpg-text-xs and rungs 11-14 floor at 11 px (R3500, R6754 'the 11 px floor'). Only rung 10 itself still stops at 10 px.

new_observations.title: The trait row's ResizeObserver is not disconnected when the sheet closes
new_observations.what: fitTraitRow keeps an observer on app._drpgTraitFit and replaces it on each render, but closeCharacterSheet disconnects only _drpgTileFit: one observer on a detached row stays per closed sheet until it is opened again. Bounded; the same shape UI-14 fixed.

new_observations.title: Two literal invisible characters are left in source after UI-15's escape
new_observations.what: A tier-2 test's regex is a character class of a literal U+00AD and a literal U+200B (an editor shows empty brackets), and the comment that shows what softWrap used to produce holds a literal soft hyphen, so it reads as the same word twice.

new_observations.title: The glass sheet's note on the notice stack describes the 1.2.42 stack
new_observations.what: The note says 'the newest at the bottom, and a card that would not fit is retired by popup.mjs'; since 22.09.2026 the newest card is prepended (on top) and what does not fit is parked and kept.

not_established: UI-09, the part left: whether Daggerheart's character settings window and Foundry's Configure Ownership carry the character as app.document on v14 and so take the sheet's size under Stained Glass. Daggerheart's class is not in this checkout; the module's own stand-in (tests-tier1.mjs:59685-59692) and anonymity.mjs:73-75 model them so. Settles it: open both on a student under Stained Glass and read position.height.

UI-11 and UI-LC4: the contrast of state-coloured text over a window's translucent ground on a bright scene. The ground is a blurred, darkened backdrop under rgba(7, 6, 11, 0.58) with a text shadow; no static figure is honest. Settles it: computed colours and a picker in Chromium over a bright map at Class Trial, Eclipse and an incident, High contrast off.

UI-12: which of the 12 sizes declared under 11 px at 100 % win the cascade under Monokuma Legacy (some are lifted by later !important rules); docs/dev/e59/GAPS.md:31 counts 21 at the slider's 80 %. Settles it: audit/style-sweep.mjs's computed sizes, or R6754's own list printed.

Whether the Projects window's delete icon is drawn in the dark GM red under the glass: the button takes #e0182f through --drpg-kit-role-destructive (styles/components.css:243, 3719) while its <i> takes the accent mix by stained-glass.css:4667 if the window carries .drpg-panel. Settles it: one computed-colour reading.
UI-LC1 and UI-LC2 have no reading on a real Foundry (E58 rows S7-12 and 16 are 'left'); their status here is the source's answer only.
UI-LC5: that a client fetches the Latin-Ext file; UI-LC6: the pulse's cost on a tablet.

The base run's results were not consulted and nothing was run from the harness: no item here carries class H. R298, R547, R1380 and the other tests are named as pins from their source, not from a result.

The report's table (AUDIT-1.2.42.md line 632) names commit 7e40243 for task 13; in this history 7e402433 is 'D8: the first text pass' and the commit titled 'Task 13' is b888c066. Which sha the report meant on its branch was not established.
coverage_note: This pass settles old items by symbol; it is not an end-to-end re-read of the UI domain.
